findings.evidence: the "invite-sent" section defines 0 controls whose target names another defined state (1 incoming link from elsewhere in the artifact).
findings.violation: This state offers no control whose target names another state the artifact defines, so a user who reaches it has no path to leave it within the artifact.
findings.fix: Add a control inside the "invite-sent" section whose target is another state the artifact defines, for example a back, cancel, or continue control.

findings.evidence: archive-confirm-copy reads: "You can restore it at any time from the archived projects list." No section, heading, or link anywhere in the artifact names or resolves to an "archived projects list"; the "project-archived" section's only control is "Back to your projects" (id project-archived-exit-link), which targets "workspace-overview".
findings.violation: NNG-H3-UNDO requires a stated reversal path for an action the artifact treats as reasonably reversible. This paragraph commits the archive action to being restorable, but no state or control anywhere in the artifact resolves to the archived projects list it names, so the promised reversal path does not exist within the artifact as specified.
findings.fix: Add an archived projects list state to the artifact, reachable by a link from the "project-archived" section or from "workspace-overview", so the restore path this paragraph promises actually resolves to something in the design.

findings.evidence: the "project-settings-save-btn" button is type="submit" inside a form with no action attribute; no confirmation message, changed control state, or next state is defined anywhere in the artifact for this submission.
findings.violation: NNG-H1 requires that a state-changing action name what the user sees once it finishes. This Save action's trigger is specified but its result feedback is not defined anywhere in the artifact.
findings.fix: Add a visible save-confirmation message or changed control state to the "project-settings" section that appears after this button is used.

instances.evidence: the "invite-member-save-btn" button is type="submit" inside a form with no action attribute; no confirmation message or next state is defined for this submission, distinct from the section's separate "Continue" control.
the "notification-settings-save-btn" button is type="submit" inside a form with no action attribute; no confirmation message or next state is defined anywhere in the artifact for this submission.

findings.location: the "invite-member" section, the "invite-member-save-btn" button and the "invite-member-continue-link" link
findings.evidence: the section defines both a type="submit" button labeled "Save" and a separate link labeled "Continue" that targets the "invite-sent" state; the artifact assigns no distinct behavior to either beyond its label.
findings.violation: NNG-H4-INTERNAL requires that one interaction pattern carry one meaning. Here two different controls, a form submit and a navigation link, both plausibly complete the single-field "Invite a team member" task, and the artifact gives no cue distinguishing what each does.
findings.fix: Remove one of the two controls, or add a stated distinction, for example labeling the link "Send invite" and defining what the Save button does if it is meant to persist a draft separately.

findings.evidence: <button> with no text content and no accessible-name attribute
findings.violation: This control has neither visible text nor an accessible-name attribute, so nothing on screen names what the control does.
findings.fix: Add visible text to this control, or an aria-label attribute naming what it does.

findings.evidence: the promo div ("Invite 3 teammates this month to unlock the advanced reporting add-on.") sits in reading order after the recent-projects list and before both of the section's action links, "Open project settings" and "View last import result".
findings.violation: NNG-H8 asks that a screen's elements serve its primary task. This section's primary task is viewing and opening a project, and a promotional element placed ahead of both action links in reading order outranks them for attention without serving that task.
findings.fix: Move the promotional div below both action links, or remove it from this screen, so it no longer sits ahead of the section's primary controls in reading order.

findings.evidence: "The last import finished with 2 rows skipped: each referenced a project that does not exist in this workspace. Rows 15 and 99 were skipped; every other row was imported." The section's only control is "import-status-exit-link", targeting "workspace-overview".
findings.violation: NNG-H9-RECOVER requires a reachable next step from an error or partial-failure state. This message names the two skipped rows and their cause but offers no control to view, fix, or retry importing just those rows, only a link back to the project list.
findings.fix: Add a control in the "import-status" section that lets the user view or retry the 2 skipped rows, for example a "Retry skipped rows" link.
